guide:
## Overview

[Qwen3.5-2B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B) is a miniature dense
Qwen3.5 model — the full gated delta networks architecture, vision encoder,
and 262K context, in a form small enough for 8 GB consumer GPUs or edge
inference.

## Prerequisites

- **vLLM version:** >= 0.17.0
- **Hardware:** single 8 GB GPU or Intel Arc Pro B60/B70

### Install vLLM

```bash
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -U vllm --torch-backend=auto
```

### Docker
```bash
docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:latest  # Intel XPU (B60 / B70)
```

## Launching the Server

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

### Docker (Intel XPU B60 / B70)

Validated on 1× Intel Arc Pro B60 / B70 (B60 24 GB, B70 32 GB per card) with the
official vLLM XPU image `vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:latest`.

```bash
docker run --device /dev/dri \
  -v /dev/dri/by-path:/dev/dri/by-path --shm-size=16g \
  --privileged --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:latest \
  Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --enforce-eager
```

## Client Usage

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="EMPTY", base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi!"}],
    max_tokens=64,
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```
